## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing playable survival-horror game.

## Requirements
- Build or update the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Keep the existing single-file Three.js game, “LAST LIGHT,” and improve gameplay reset and input reliability.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed restart state so the hunter aura, exit gate, generator progress, health, input, and toast state reset.
- Prevented tree collision from dividing by zero and potentially corrupting player position.
- Added input clearing on browser blur and reset the touch joystick position on restart.
- `node --check` passed for the extracted game module; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Finish validation and report the game’s controls and assumptions.

### Blocked
- Browser playtesting was blocked because Chromium is not installed: `Browser "chromium" is not installed`.

## Next Move
1. Review the current diff and perform browser playtesting if Chromium becomes available.
2. Summarize the finished game, controls, assumptions, and any unverified behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Game UI, Three.js scene, controls, and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` are uncommitted.
- The game uses a Three.js module from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- The attempted local server on port `3002` did not remain running.
